'''Gutkurrs''' were fierce creatures native to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

==Biology==
{{Quote|These suckers won't give up!|[[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]], seeing the gutkurrs' determination|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>}}
[[File:GutkurrsFeed-IoR.png|thumb|left|250x250px|A pair of gutkurrs feed on a dead [[Can-cell/Legends|can-cell]]]]
Gutkurrs had both reptilian and insectoid characteristics. Their two-legged gait was very similar to that of a reptilian [[Species/Legends|species]], whereas their hard-shelled, spined carapace and sharp-mandible heads appeared very insect-like. They were approximately two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high, and their tough hide and carapace were able to withstand several blaster shots.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> Although their shell and internal insulation allowed them to survive for short periods on the frigid nigth side of Ryloth, the gutkurr tipically made its home in the twiligth area, preferring to stay out of the intense hear of the day side of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name=":0">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

Always on the hunt for their next meal,<ref name="The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril">''[[The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril]]''</ref> they were surprisingly intelligent creatures that, while absolutely vicious, maintained a level of cunning exceeding that of other predators.<ref name=":0" /> They made a noise that sounds between a roar and a hiss.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> Gutkurrs sometimes travelled througth the nigth side of the planet, ambushing unwary travelers.<ref name=":0" />

Young gutkurrs were referred as gutkurr chicks. They were small enougth that could wonder around [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] markets, though parents warned their children to not touch them.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew">''[[The Clone Wars: Curfew]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Gutkurr! Gutkurr!|[[Numa/Legends|Numa]], upon seeing a pair of gutkurrs|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
[[File:Gutkurr_attack.jpg|thumb|250x250px|A gutkurr attacks a clone trooper.]]
Gutkurrs were native from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], but for centuries they have been exported by crime lords as pets. Gutkurrs were intelligent enough to be trained - but only by those brave enough to approach the massive predators.<ref name=":0" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 24">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 24|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 24]] {{C|22 BBY 85-86: The Struggle for Toydaria}}</ref> gutkurrs were used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]] in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the battle, gutkurrs were used to attack clone troopers as they entered the village of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]]. They proved to be very lethal, killing at least half a dozen [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] troops. This was because they had not been fed in a while. TX-20 did not feed them to make them more lethal when fighting clones. They were defeated when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] lured them into an alley with the Force, which the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] sealed off with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. Two broke off from the main group and attacked Waxer, Boil and Numa. The trio managed to escape through a tunnel.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />
